'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Mike Richards DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' mr007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
